We offer several packages to fit your needs, starting from £1,500 per month for our "Simple" plan. The price scales based on the features you require, from a straightforward quote & buy ("Simple") to a full multi-tiered distribution platform for MGAs ("Pro Plus") and custom "Enterprise" builds. What is the "banded licence fee model"? Our licence fee is tied to your growth, structured in bands based on your GWP (Gross Written Premium) levels. For higher GWP bands, the licence fee can be partially offset by a transaction fee arrangement, offering you more commercial flexibility. What's the main difference between the Simple, Pro, and Pro Plus plans? The plans are designed for different business needs: Simple is a fast, straightforward quote & buy solution for a single brand. Pro adds more complexity, including more risk questions, a "retrieve quote" feature, direct debit, and HubSpot CRM integration. Pro Plus is built for MGAs, adding multi-tiered distribution , unlimited brokers, white labeling, and commission management . Are full policy lifecycle features (like MTAs and Renewals) included? Not in the standard packages, as some businesses don't need them. Full policy lifecycle features (including MTAs, Renewals, and Cancellations) and Claims (FNOL) are available as separate add-on modules that can be added to the Pro, Pro Plus, and Enterprise plans. Who is the Enterprise plan for? The Enterprise plan is for businesses with highly complex or unique requirements. It's a fully bespoke solution where our fees are subject to complexity. This plan can include specialist consultancy, insight-led bespoke design, custom development, and integrations with AI or chatbot services. What is included in the monthly licence fee? The licence fee is designed for transparency and value. It covers all platform support, maintenance, and upgrades . It also permits you to build unlimited products and process unlimited transactions , so you are not penalized for growth. Can we try the platform on a small project first? Yes. For new ideas, we offer a Digital PoC (Proof of Concept) , in partnership with Insurance Times. This is a one-off project, starting from just £995, designed to help you quickly test a new proposition in the market.
